_comment: The quiz block of the container definition. Hand-authored for now; SET UP (hit list 22) will generate this file one day, so nothing in here should be something a generator couldn't write. The engine reads it via /api/quiz and the FEEDER dresses it live — the rail is fixed, the dressing is live. The patter fields are the fallback: if the FEEDER call fails, the robot asks the plain version, in character, and nobody can tell.
tagline: Fill in the blanks. The robot does the rest.

tools.dig_why: Search lands with hit list 9. Flip this true when the engine exists — the circle simply doesn't render until then.

questions.title: What's this all about?
questions.patter: The story in your words. Don't sweat the details.
questions.placeholder: 'Coldplay tickets, gold circle, our members would lose their minds...' Or just dump in a brief.
questions.why: Your story here sets the feel of the whole email — the headline and the body grow out of how you tell it. The boring facts I'll chase at the checklist.

questions.title: Dump your docs
questions.patter: What have you got lying around? Paste it, drop it, whatever exists.
questions.placeholder: Paste anything — the brief, the T&Cs, last year's email...
questions.why: I read whatever you drop and pull the facts out myself — dates, venues, prize names — so you don't have to type them. Rough is fine. Nothing is fine too.

questions.title: Why will anyone care?
questions.patter: The human hook. What makes this one matter?
questions.placeholder: 'First show here in twelve years. One night. That's it.'
questions.why: This is the difference between an email and a reason to enter. One honest line beats three polished ones.

closing: That's the three. Off to check the facts —
